stdout.reason: small linear story (2 nodes, low branching)

stdout.label: Layered pipeline (data / request flow)
stdout.notes: Spine on the same row → straight horizontal edges; offset edges use 2 waypoints through the middle of the gap.

stdout.label: Hierarchy / org tree (Landing Zone, org structure)
stdout.notes: Fan from one parent through a shared lane right below the parent → looks like a branching bus.

stdout.label: VPC network topology (Multi-AZ)
stdout.notes: STANDARD VPC LAYOUT: each Availability Zone is a VERTICAL COLUMN, the AZs sit side by side, and the VPC is the horizontal box that wraps them (Region → VPC → AZ columns → subnets). Inside an AZ, subnets are tiers stacked top→bottom (e.g. Public, then Private/App, then Data); keep the SAME tier aligned horizontally across AZs (public-a level with public-b). A shared LB/NAT/bus spans HORIZONTALLY across the AZ columns; replication/DR between mirrored AZs uses dashed edges.

stdout.label: Hub-and-spoke / event bus
stdout.notes: Place the hub (bus/TGW/EventBridge) at the middle of the row; spokes connect horizontally on both sides (exitX=1 / exitX=0) → no crossing.

stdout.label: Hybrid / DR (on-prem ↔ cloud)
stdout.notes: Two sites as separate blocks; connect via a Direct Connect/VPN node; mirror the components on both sides; bidirectional link uses dashed edges.

stdout.label: Multi-account connectivity / service mesh (VPC Lattice · TGW · peering · RAM)
stdout.notes: Accounts are peer containers; one shared/network account at the center, the other accounts 'associate' to it (service network / TGW / RAM share). Association/sharing edges are clearly labeled; prefer hub-and-spoke through the shared account over a many-to-many mesh (Well-Architected REL02-BP04).

stdout.label: Sequence / interaction (numbered request walkthrough)
stdout.notes: Number the steps along the request flow (1→N) on the architecture diagram; each arrow carries a sequence number; read by number, edges need not all point the same way.

stdout.label: BPMN swimlane process (roles × phases)
stdout.notes: Horizontal swimlanes: lanes = roles stacked vertically, phases = vertical milestone bands with a header row. Sequence flow stays within a pool (solid); message flow connects pools (dashed). One start event top-left, end events on the right; gateways where paths split/merge.
